content: Ananias sola Safira bonno' natumang pa'palakona
Dengan duka' mesa tau disanga Ananias sola bainena disanga Safira umbaluk salaoan litakna.
Nasituru'imi bainena la umpatorro sabarean alli litakna anna sabareanna nabaa lako rasul.
Sapo' ma'kada Petrus lako nakua: “O Ananias maakari anna kuasai ponggawana setang penawammu mupolalan tae' ungkaloloi Penawa Masero umpatorro sabarean alli litakmu?

Inde ammu ta'pa umbaluk litakmue, iko ummampuii. Mangkai mubaluk iko liu siamo ummampui allinna. Dadi maakari anna kendek illalan penawammu la ma'gau' susi? Tangngia angga lako ma'rupa tau mungei tae' mantula' tongan sapo' langngan duka' Puang Allata'alla.”
Tappana urrangngi tula'na Petrus songka siami Ananias anna kattu penawanna. Marea' asan angganna to urrangngi kadadian iatoo.
Saemi pira-pira anak muane umbalun batang rabukna Ananias anna mane lao ullamunni.
Umbai tallui tettek mangkanna, saemi duka' bainena sapo' tae' naissanan aka mane mangka dadi.
Ma'kadami Petrus lako nakua: “Tulasanna' sitonganna, angga tongammika te pada alli litakmua'e?” Natimba' inde bainee nakua: “Io, angga tongammi tu padao.”
Nakuamo Petrus: “Maakari ammu situru'ia' muanemu la ussandak-sandak Penawa Maserona Dewata? Perangngii, itin lako tauo mane sule lao ullamun muanemu, ia siamo duka' la lao ullamungko.”
Songka siami dio tingngayona Petrus anna pa'de penawanna. Saei tama inde mai anak muanee bonno'mi nalambi'. Nabullemi lao anna lamunni dio sa'dena muanena.
Marea' tongan-tongammi angganna to mangngorean anna mentu'na to urrangngi kara-kara iatoo.
Ma'rupa-rupa tanda anna tanda memangnga-mangnga
Buda tanda anna tanda memangnga-mangnga napadadi rasul illalan alla'-alla'na tau buda. Sima'mesami to mangngorean dio Sali-salinna Salomo dio Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla.
Tae' dengan tau senga' la barani umpentappaii, sapo' moi susi too natayuk liu duka' tau buda.
Samasae-saena sakerangngan-rangnganna to mangngorean lako Puang Yesus, susi muane tenni baine.

Lambisan buda tau umbaa to masakinna lako lalan anna pamamma'i dio angngenan mammasan battu ampa' dio biring lalan. Annu nakua moi podo kalimbayonamo Petrus ke liui urrua sala' bennanna inde to masakie tae' mala tamalapu'.
Buda duka' tau sae dio mai tondok sikadappi'na Yerusalem umbaa to masakinna anna to natamai setang. Angganna tau iatoo dipomalapu'.
Pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi undarra rasul annu mangungngu' penawa
Mangungngu' penawami Pongkena Imam sola angganna to unturu'i iamo to Saduki, aka sabuda-budannamo tau ummorean Puang Yesus,
napolalan umpealai angganna rasul anna patamai tarungkun.
Sapo' bongii saemi mesa malaeka'na Puang Allata'alla untungka'i ba'ba tarungkun anna pasunni anna ma'kada nakua:
“Laokoa' lako Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla ammu ulelean kareba katuoan bakaru lako tau buda.”

Unturu'mi kadanna malaeka' rasul, napolalan mebongngi'-bongngi' lako Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla ma'pa'guru. Marassanni ma'pa'guru rasul, mesuami Pongkena Imam sola to unturu'i untambai angganna pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi battu dikua perepi'na to Israel anna ma'mesa. Anna mane ussua tau lao ummala angganna rasul tama tarungkun.
Sapo' saei lako pa'tarungkunan pa'de asammia rasul illaan, napolalan ma'pasule anna ma'kada lako nakua:
“Saekan lako pa'tarungkunan manda' ba'ba tikado' anna lako siamo sa'de ba'ba to daga. Sapo' untungka'ikan ba'ba ta'mo dengan tau illalan.”
Mangnga-mangnga inde kapalana to siundagai Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'allae sola angganna kapala imam urrangngi tula'na inde taue, anna pusa' umpikki' battu akamo la dadi.
Tapakala sae mesa tau umbaa kareba nakua: “Perangngia'i, iato to mupatamaa' tarungkunno, illalan asammi Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla marassan ma'pa'guru lako tau kamban.”
Mengkalao siami kapalana to siundagai Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla sola pira-pira to sidio sa'dena lao ummala rasul, sapo' tae' naparrang annu marea' la naleba'i batu tau buda.
Nabaami lako tingngayona pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi. Naparessami Pongkena Imam nakua:
“Kusanga mangkamokoa' kidapai la umpa'pa'guruan itin tau disanga Yesus-o. Sapo' tuttuan ussambairokoa' iko Yerusalem untetteranni anna moraikoa' la umpatumangngikan kamateanna itin tauo.”
Natimba'mi Petrus sola solana nakua: “Tangngia kami pa'kuanna ma'rupa tau la kituru' sapo' pa'kuanna Puang Allata'alla.
Aka Puang Yesus, to mupopepateia' yao kayu pantokesan, mangkami napatuo sule dio mai alla'na to mate Puang Allata'alla to napenombai neneta.

Mangkami nabeen kamatandean anna kakuasaan Puang Allata'alla mendadi Perepi' anna To umpasalama' ma'rupa tau, anna malara dengan lalan la naola to Israel mengkatoba' anna digarri'i angganna kasalaanna.
Kamimo ussa'bii angganna kara-kara iatoo. Nasa'bii toi duka' Penawa Maserona Puang Allata'alla mangka napa'kamasean lako to unturu' Puang Yesus.”
Tappana urrangngi kadanna Petrus, rede siami ara'na pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi napolalan nasituru'-turu'i la umpatei angganna rasul.

Sapo' dio duka' reen mesa to Farisi disanga Gamaliel to nakala' kombongan pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi. Inde Gamaliel-e mesa to untarru' issinna Sura'na Musa anna naangga' tau kamban. Ke'de' anna ussua tau umpasuun rasul lako salian sappai'.
Le'bai ma'kadami lako inde to ma'mesae nakua: “O to Israel pikki' manappaia' aka la mupogau' lako inde mai taue.

Annu yolona dengan kendek mesa tau disanga Teudas, to ussanga-sanga kalena, napolalan umbai appa' ratu' tau unturu'i boko'na, sapo' dipatei lambisan sisarak-sarak babang to unturu'i, katampakan pa'de babang.

Mangkai too, attunna anna parrekenan ma'rupa tau, kendek pole omi Yudas to Galilea anna buda tau menturu' lako, la umbali to ma'parenta. Sapo' katampakanna dipatei anna sisarak-sarak babang duka' to unturu'i.
Dadi, kupakilalakoa' temo kumua tae'koa' la umpogau' aka-aka lako inde taue. Pabeai mammi, annu ianna pa'kua rupa taura pa'tangnga'na sola pa'palakona innang tokke' sia la pa'de babang.

Sapo' ianna situru'ra pa'kuanna Puang Allata'alla innang tae' la mubela mutaloia', anna bennara ummissananni ke dako' anna Puang Allata'allamo iko mubalia'.” Inde tula'na Gamaliel-e natarima pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi.
Untambaimi sule rasul anna popekambeii, anna dapaii umpa'pa'guruan liu Puang Yesus, anna mane rappananni.
Dore' asammi rasul umpellei kombongan pa'bisara alukna to Yahudi aka nasa'ding kumua: “Naangga'kia' Puang Allata'alla sipato' untarima pandarraan ura'na sanganna Puang Yesus.”
Allo-allona ma'pa'guru liu illalan Banua Ada'na Puang Allata'alla sola lako banuanna tau anna ummulelean Kareba Kadoresan kumua Puang Yesus iamo To nabassei bayu-bayu Puang Allata'alla.
